Who we are:
Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.
Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers - from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses - across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.
About the Role
Motive is scaling fast, and our Quote-to-Cash engine needs to keep up. The QTC pipeline processes 5,000+ daily orders across 100k+ customers and is critical to IPO readiness and SOX compliance.
As a Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer on the QTC team, you will be a senior member of the engineering team that builds and maintains Motives Quote-to-Cash stack: Salesforce CPQ, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue (RevPro), NetSuite, Vertex, and n8n/MuleSoft integrations. You will tackle some of the most impactful engineering challenges in the company: ensuring every order flows seamlessly from quote to billing to revenue recognition without manual intervention or data gaps.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role for an engineer who has lived in the Quote-to-Cash or Lead-to-Cash space for years and understands how quoting, billing, revenue recognition, and ERP systems connect. You will solve problems around order automation, billing accuracy, integration reliability, and proactive monitoring that keeps our revenue pipeline healthy as we scale toward an IPO.
We believe in an "everyone is a builder" mentality. Everyone on this team is capable of being a forward-thinking engineer, not just executing tickets but shaping how systems are designed and built. You will build headless apps that surface QTC data and workflows where users already work, and you will leverage AI to accelerate how we work, from agentic development workflows to AI-assisted order processing and intelligent automation across the stack.

Job Summary

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and grow the software engineering team responsible for a critical virtual appliance that customers deploy within their private environments. The appliance provides a secure, reliable connection between customer-managed systems and SailPoint Identity Security. You will own engineering execution, collaborate with Product Management on the roadmap, and help the team deliver meaningful customer outcomes with greater speed and predictability.

In a typical day, you may coach an engineer, review an architectural proposal, refine sprint priorities, coordinate a release or incident follow-up with a peer team, and communicate roadmap progress and risks. You will not be expected to write code routinely, but you will be technically engaged: able to read code, understand the systems your team owns, ask insightful questions, and guide sound decisions involving Linux, virtualization, containerization, and customer-deployed software.

You will continue developing the team's Scrum practices around a predictable two-week sprint cadence while preserving the flexibility to respond to urgent customer and operational needs. You will also champion responsible use of modern AI and LLM capabilities to improve engineering effectiveness, quality, decision-making, and business outcomes.

This role is based in India. Candidates may work remotely, in a hybrid arrangement, or from SailPoint's Pune office. Substantial daily overlap with U.S. working hours is required. Periodic team gatherings in the United States provide optional opportunities for in-person collaboration and travel.

Responsibilities

Roadmap for Success

The following milestones describe how success in this role will be measured. Specific delivery and reliability targets will be established using current platform and team baselines.

30 days

  • Build trusted working relationships with every team member and key partners across Product Management, architecture, security, vulnerability management, release engineering, and support.
  • Develop a working understanding of the platform architecture, codebase, roadmap, release lifecycle, customer experience, operational history, and major technical risks.
  • Assess the team s current delivery practices, staffing needs, and near-term priorities, then share a focused 90-day action plan with stakeholders.

90 days

  • Establish a consistent two-week Scrum cadence with clear backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and visible progress against commitments.
  • Agree with Product Management and technical partners on a prioritized stabilization plan, roadmap sequencing, and baseline measures for delivery predictability and platform reliability.
  • Define and begin executing a hiring and team-development plan aligned with the roadmap.

6 months

  • Demonstrate measurable improvement against the delivery and reliability baselines established during the first 90 days.
  • Deliver the highest-priority platform stabilization work while maintaining visible progress on customer-focused roadmap commitments.
  • Strengthen production ownership through effective incident response, learning reviews, vulnerability remediation, and follow-through on reliability improvements.
  • Introduce practical, responsible AI-assisted workflows that produce demonstrable improvements in engineering quality, decision-making, or delivery efficiency.
  • Make measurable progress against the agreed hiring plan and ensure every engineer has clear expectations, feedback, and development goals.

1 year

  • Deliver meaningful roadmap milestones that improve how customers deploy, upgrade, operate, and rely on the virtual appliance.
  • Establish and begin executing a multi-quarter technical strategy for the platform s continued modernization and architectural evolution.
  • Build a stronger, appropriately staffed team with clear ownership, healthy collaboration, and demonstrated growth in both people and technical capability.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing and developing software engineers.
  • Proven experience leading teams that build customer-installed applications, virtual appliances, connectors, gateways, or comparable software deployed in customer-managed environments.
  • Experience building software that securely connects customer environments with cloud-based SaaS services.
  • Strong technical understanding of Linux, virtualization, and containerization, with the ability to read and understand code and contribute meaningfully to architecture and design discussions.
  • Experience managing the lifecycle of customer-deployed software, including distribution, upgrades, patching, compatibility, diagnostics, vulnerability remediation, and incident response.
  • Demonstrated success implementing and refining Agile/Scrum practices to create predictable delivery while responding effectively to urgent needs.
  • Experience hiring, mentoring, managing performance, and supporting the career development of engineers.
  • Excellent planning, reporting, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Experience leading distributed teams and collaborating effectively across time zones.
  • Hands-on fluency with modern AI and LLM tools, including experience using reusable skills and agents to achieve engineering and business outcomes and sound judgment about when an agent, skill, or conversational assistant is the right approach.

Position: Project Head Digital Transformation & Enterprise Technology


Company: Ishan World
Location: Agra, Uttar Pradesh
Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site
Department: Digital Transformation & Enterprise Systems
Reporting To: Director / Management
Experience: 7-10 +Years
Salary: 90,000 to 1,20,000 per month, depending on experience and capability
About the Role
Ishan World is building an integrated Digital Operating Platform to transform its complete business ecosystem, covering:
ERP | CRM | Retail/POS | B2B & B2C | Inventory | Purchase | Vendor Management | Logistics | Projects | HRMS | Finance Integrations | Customer & Partner Portals | Mobile Applications | Analytics | AI | Automation | Enterprise Integrations
A substantial business architecture, requirement repository and initial software platform are already in place.
We are looking for an experienced Project Head Digital Transformation & Enterprise Technology who can take end-to-end ownership of the existing programme and lead it through technical validation, ERP evaluation, architecture finalisation, development, integration, testing, implementation and production rollout.
This is NOT a conventional IT Manager role.
The selected candidate will be expected to take technical and execution ownership across:
Existing Software + Open-Source ERP + Custom Applications + APIs + Data + Infrastructure + AI + Technical Team + Testing + Deployment
The candidate will initially evaluate Odoo Community, ERPNext/Frappe and the existing Ishan World platform and recommend the most technically suitable, scalable and economical architecture.
The decision should be based on business requirements and technical suitability not simply on prior familiarity with a particular ERP.
Key Responsibilities

  • Take complete ownership of the existing digital transformation programme.
  • Understand and evaluate the existing software, architecture, GitHub repositories and development history.
  • Review the current Django/Python/PostgreSQL platform and existing custom development.
  • Review previous Odoo implementation/configuration wherever applicable.
  • Map approved business requirements against existing systems and identify gaps.
  • Conduct a detailed Odoo Community vs ERPNext/Frappe vs Existing Platform fit-gap analysis.
  • Recommend the final technology and ERP architecture, including cost-to-complete and long-term ownership considerations.
  • Identify what should be reused, configured, integrated or newly developed.
  • Lead ERP, backend, web/mobile, API, AI and integration development.
  • Manage and mentor a lean internal technical team.
  • Coordinate and technically supervise external consultants/vendors where required.
  • Own testing, UAT, data migration, deployment, go-live and post-go-live stabilisation.
  • Establish strong practices around Git/GitHub, code review, documentation, CI/CD and release management.
  • Oversee Linux/server, database, security and infrastructure architecture.
  • Ensure appropriate authentication, permissions, data security and system controls.
  • Control unnecessary customisation, duplication and technology costs.
  • Ensure business requirements and processes are accurately translated into scalable software solutions.
  • Build an integrated, modular and scalable enterprise technology ecosystem.

Required Experience

  • 7-10 years of experience in ERP, enterprise software, digital transformation or technology leadership.
  • Experience managing at least 2 significant end-to-end ERP/enterprise-system implementations.
  • Proven experience from requirement gathering to development, testing, implementation and go-live.
  • Strong experience with at least one major ERP or open-source ERP platform.
  • Experience leading developers and technical resources.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, databases, APIs and enterprise integrations.
  • Ability to independently evaluate technical solutions and make architecture-level decisions.

Technical Skills
Strong working knowledge of several of the following:

  • Odoo and/or ERPNext/Frappe
  • Python
  • Django or comparable backend frameworks
  • PostgreSQL / SQL / MariaDB
  • REST APIs & system integrations
  • Git / GitHub
  • Linux / Ubuntu
  • Docker
  • Web & mobile application architecture
  • Authentication & access control
  • Data migration and database management
  • Enterprise integrations
  • AI APIs / LLM-based solutions
  • Automation platforms

Experience with both Odoo and ERPNext is preferred but not mandatory.
We value strong technical judgement, enterprise architecture experience and execution capability more than expertise in only one ERP platform.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a technology leader who naturally asks:

  • What already exists?
  • What can be reused?
  • What can standard ERP handle?
  • What genuinely requires customisation?
  • What should remain within the existing Ishan World platform?
  • How should different systems and modules integrate?
  • How will the solution be tested and deployed?
  • What is the safest, scalable and most economical approach?

We Are NOT Looking For

  • A coordination-only IT Manager.
  • Someone who cannot independently evaluate technical decisions.
  • Someone who wants to discard existing development without technical/business justification.
  • Someone who recommends an ERP only because they are familiar with it.
  • Someone who heavily customises standard ERP functionality unnecessarily.
  • Someone who starts development without understanding business requirements.
  • Someone who accepts incomplete testing or weak deployment practices.
  • Someone who creates isolated systems or duplicate masters.
  • Someone who is completely dependent on external vendors for technical understanding.

Success in This Role
The successful candidate will help build one integrated Digital Operating Environment connecting:
People + Processes + Products + Customers + Partners + Transactions + Controls + Data + Intelligence
across the Ishan World business ecosystem.
Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates should be prepared for a practical technical and business case discussion in addition to the regular interview process.
If you have the technical depth, enterprise mindset and execution capability to take ownership of a large-scale digital transformation programme, we would like to hear from you.

The selected candidate will be expected to take technical and execution ownership across:
Existing Software + Open-Source ERP + Custom Applications + APIs + Data + Infrastructure + AI + Technical Team + Testing + Deployment
The candidate will initially evaluate Odoo Community, ERPNext/Frappe and the existing Ishan World platform and recommend the most technically suitable, scalable and economical architecture.

  • Lead ERP, backend, web/mobile, API, AI and integration development.
  • Manage and mentor a lean internal technical team.
  • Coordinate and technically supervise external consultants/vendors where required.
  • Own testing, UAT, data migration, deployment, go-live and post-go-live stabilisation.
  • Establish strong practices around Git/GitHub, code review, documentation, CI/CD and release management.
  • Oversee Linux/server, database, security and infrastructure architecture.
  • Ensure appropriate authentication, permissions, data security and system controls.
  • Control unnecessary customisation, duplication and technology costs.
  • Ensure business requirements and processes are accurately translated into scalable software solutions.
  • Build an integrated, modular and scalable enterprise technology ecosystem.

Required Experience

  • 7-10 years of experience in ERP, enterprise software, digital transformation or technology leadership.
  • Experience managing at least 2 significant end-to-end ERP/enterprise-system implementations.
  • Proven experience from requirement gathering to development, testing, implementation and go-live.
  • Strong experience with at least one major ERP or open-source ERP platform.

  • PostgreSQL / SQL / MariaDB
  • REST APIs & system integrations

  • Authentication & access control
  • Data migration and database management
  • Enterprise integrations
  • AI APIs / LLM-based solutions

Experience with both Odoo and ERPNext is preferred but not mandatory.
We value strong technical judgement, enterprise architecture experience and execution capability more than expertise in only one ERP platform.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a technology leader who naturally asks:

  • What already exists?
  • What can be reused?
  • What can standard ERP handle?
  • What genuinely requires customisation?
  • What should remain within the existing Ishan World platform?
  • How should different systems and modules integrate?
  • How will the solution be tested and deployed?

across the Ishan World business ecosystem.

Develop a strong understanding of MongoDBs marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.

Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. About Skan AI
Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution
At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the worlds largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.
Why Skan AI
Were in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, were uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, were the only company that can bridge the gap between AIs promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.
About the Role
Skan AI Agents ships into some of the most complex, regulated workflows in the enterprise, claims adjudication, underwriting, loan operations, compliance. We need a Principal Product Marketing Manager who will define how Skan AI talks about agentic AI as a category, not just launch individual features, while maintaining the technical fluency to earn credibility with engineering, sales, and the enterprise buyers evaluating whether an agent is actually ready for production.
Heres the distinction at the center of that story: deploying an agent isnt the hard part anymore, everyones doing that. Operationalizing it, reliably and safely enough to run claims or underwriting in production, is. Thats the argument youll be sharpening and telling, across every audience that needs to hear it.
This role sits at the intersection of technical product understanding and go-to-market strategy, youll embed deeply with the Agents product team to shape the roadmaps story, then set the positioning and launch strategy that marketing, sales, and customer success build on. Youll own the narrative for Skan AI Agents end to end, with the latitude to define how its positioned.
Responsibilities
  • Strategic Positioning Messaging
    • Define and own the positioning strategy for Skan AI Agents and the category narrative for agentic AI at Skan AI overall
    • Develop crisp, technically accurate messaging that translates Agents capabilities, deterministic-first execution, governed reasoning, full auditability, into clear value for CIOs, Chief AI Officers, and operations leaders
    • Keep Agents positioning grounded in the Context Graph of Work and consistent with Skan AIs broader platform narrative
  • Launch Orchestration
    • Own the end-to-end launch process for Agents features and capabilities, from early roadmap discussions with product and engineering through post-launch analysis
    • Build and maintain launch calendars, coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, and ensure consistent messaging across every channel
  • Content Sales Enablement
    • Build a content portfolio spanning thought leadership, solution briefs, web copy, and whitepapers that speaks credibly to both technical and business buyers
    • Create competitive battle cards, demo scripts, and objection-handling materials that help sales articulate why Agents performs in production where other approaches stall in pilot
    • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to build reference stories and proof points from real deployments
  • Competitive Intelligence
    • Monitor the fast-moving agentic AI landscape to inform positioning and sharpen differentiation as the competitive set continues to shift
    • Translate competitive shifts into concrete messaging and sales-facing guidance
  • Qualifications
    • 7+ years of experience in product marketing, with demonstrated Principal-level ownership of positioning and strategy.
    • Meaningful time in technical, developer-adjacent, or platform/API product marketing
    • Demonstrated ability to work directly with product and engineering teams, translating technical capability into business value for enterprise buyers
    • Strong project management skills, with experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder launches
    • Exceptional written communication, particularly clear, precise technical messaging
    • Experience building sales enablement, competitive positioning, and demo materials
  • Nice to Have
    • Engineering background, technical degree, or prior hands-on technical role
    • Experience marketing to enterprise buyers in banking, insurance, or other regulated industries
    • Familiarity with agentic AI, process intelligence, or automation platform categories
    • Experience partnering directly with engineering or applied AI teams

Not all strong candidates will meet every qualification listed. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your background doesnt match every bullet point above.

We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

jobDescription:
Job Description
Job Title: Group Lead IT, Platform Engineering
Band: 11
Location: Bangalore, India
Reports to: Paul Eastman, Head of Product Platforms Engineering (PPE)
Job Summary
Kraft Heinzs Product Platforms Engineering (PPE) organisation is building a single, India-based Platform Engineering capability that brings our DevOps and Quality Engineering platform teams together under one leader. This is a brand-new leadership role: you will design, build and run the team, the toolset and the operating model from the outset, rather than inherit an established function.
The mission of the Platform Engineering function is to make it fast, safe and easy for every engineer at Kraft Heinz, human or AI-assisted, to build, test and run high-quality digital products. You will own the full platform stack end to end: CI/CD, project management, observability, and the Quality Engineering and test automation toolset. You will define the platforms strategy, service catalogue and governance, and you will lead a growing India-based team of managers and engineers, working closely with our delivery partner HCLTech under our "Autonomous Operations" model.
This role sits on the PPE leadership team alongside the Product Engineering Chapter Lead and the Power Platform Lead, and is directly accountable for modernising a large technology estate, and aligning platform delivery to Kraft Heinzs Reference Architecture.
Key Responsibilities
Platform Strategy Governance
  • Own and evolve the strategy for the combined DevOps and Quality Engineering platform, defining the service catalogue, availability, configuration and release lifecycle for each capability.
  • Govern the platforms that enable Kraft Heinzs engineering community to build, test, deploy and operate digital products, and be accountable for service performance definition, measurement and reporting.
  • Drive rationalisation of a toolset that currently spans 20+ tools and technologies, making deliberate, evidence-based decisions on where to consolidate and where to invest, in line with our Capable, Lean Healthy strategy.
  • Align platform architecture and controls to Kraft Heinzs Reference Architecture
Team Leadership Talent Development
  • Build, structure and lead the India-based Platform Engineering team from the ground up, starting with the Testing Platform Manager and DevOps Platform Delivery Manager as direct reports, growing the function toward its target headcount over time.
  • Recruit, coach and develop platform and test engineers, establishing Kraft Heinz as a location of choice for platform engineering talent in India.
  • Set clear objectives, career pathways and performance standards for the team, fostering a culture of ownership, engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Act as a member of Paul Eastmans PPE leadership team, contributing to organisation design, workforce planning and cross-chapter initiatives beyond the immediate platform remit.
DevSecOps Toolset Ownership
  • Ensure the smooth, secure operation of the DevSecOps toolset, including CI/CD (e.g. GitHub, Azure DevOps), security and compliance tooling (vulnerability scanning, secrets management) and monitoring/logging tooling (e.g. PagerDuty, New Relic, Grafana).
  • Collaborate with development teams and the Software Engineering chapter to ensure DevSecOps capabilities are seamlessly integrated into the software development lifecycle.
  • Work with the security team to ensure the platform meets organisational security policy and regulatory requirements.
Quality Engineering Test Transformation
  • Own the Quality Engineering and test automation toolset - test case management, test automation, performance/load testing and test optimisation - and drive its modernisation.
  • Lead the transformation of a large legacy manual test estate toward AI-powered, automated test orchestration, addressing known gaps such as automation script generation for legacy tooling.
  • Evaluate and implement new QE and test orchestration tools and technologies, building the business case and driving adoption of best practice across the organisation.
Delivery Partner Stakeholder Management
  • Manage day-to-day delivery and performance of HCLTech and other service partners against the "Autonomous Operations model, ensuring scalable, secure and integrated services that Product teams can trust.
  • Work closely with Global IT and other PPE chapters to ensure new initiatives with up/downstream impact on the platform are coordinated and aligned.
  • Represent the platform in governance forums and executive updates, communicating strategy, risk and progress clearly to senior stakeholders.
Service Operations Performance
  • Execute platform governance - routines, controls and monitoring - and continuously improve them to drive better performance.
  • Own incident, problem and change management for the platform, ensuring reliable, well-supported services for the engineering community.
  • Manage delivery of new platform features, integrations and capabilities in line with the platforms roadmap and PPEs wider strategy.
Requirements
  • 8+ years of experience in IT/engineering, including significant experience in DevOps, platform engineering or quality engineering leadership roles.
  • Proven people leadership experience, including managing managers and building or scaling a team, ideally within an international or offshore/India delivery model.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise DevSecOps tooling, with a preference for GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira and Confluence.
  • Working knowledge of Quality Engineering and test automation tooling (e.g. HP ALM/Worksoft, Selenium, LoadRunner, test optimisation platforms such as Panaya or LiveCompare).
  • Proven experience of platform management, including:
  • Defining platform strategies
  • Scaling platforms in an internationally distributed environment
  • Implementing platform governance
  • Assessing and selecting platform technologies
  • Broad technology experience beyond platform management, including project scoping and delivery, requirements analysis, solution/process design, systems administration and solution architecture.
  • Experience managing outsourced or managed-service delivery partners against agreed service levels.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, with a preference for Microsoft Azure (including AKS/Container Apps).
  • Strong understanding of security and compliance principles, with experience implementing security controls and monitoring for vulnerabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience operating credibly with senior (VP/CIO-level) stakeholders.
  • Experience of working in diverse global teams and as part of large matrix organisations.
Nice to Have
  • Exposure to AI-assisted software delivery - e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or similar agentic engineering tooling - and an interest in AI-native ways of working.
  • Experience with AI-powered test orchestration or self-healing test automation platforms.
  • Certification in DevSecOps, Quality Engineering, or an IT service management framework (e.g. ITIL).
  • Experience with agile delivery at scale (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Knowledge or experience gained from within the CPG industry would be an advantage.
Qualifications - Soft Skills
  • Empathy - you listen more than you talk, understand your internal customers deeply, and use that understanding to improve their experience of the platform.
  • Ability to Simplify - you keep things simple and move fast, translating complex challenges into simple, adoptable solutions.
  • Proactive - you are a self-starter who drives initiatives through to completion and is comfortable challenging the status quo to get the right result.
  • Analytical - you use data to guide decisions, translating complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Communication Skills - you communicate clearly and confidently in writing and verbally, including with senior leadership.
  • People Leadership - you build trust quickly, develop talent, and create an environment where engineers do their best work.
  • Project Programme Management - you are organised and structured, and can bring multiple large-scale initiatives to a successful conclusion within agreed timeframes.
Location(s) Bengaluru - Brookfield GCC

jobDescription:
About US:
Systango Technologies Limited (NSE: SYSTANGO) is a digital engineering company that offers enterprise-class IT and product engineering services to different size organizations. At Systango, we have a culture of efficiency - we use the best-in-breed technologies to commit quality at speed and world-class support to address critical business challenges. We leverage Gen AI, AI/Machine Learning and Blockchain to unlock the next stage of digitalization for traditional businesses. Our handpicked team is adept at web enterprise development, mobile apps, QA and DevOps. Sila, Cuentas, Youtility, Porsche, MGM Grand, Deloitte, Grindr, and Tawk.to are some of the top clients that have entrusted us to enhance their digital capabilities and build disruptive innovations. We believe in making the impossible, possible and we do it literally.

About the Role
We are looking for a Business Manager - Finance, Operations Governance to work closely with the CEO and leadership team, taking ownership of financial reporting, business operations, governance, risk coordination, investor reporting, and commercial oversight.
This is a broad, hands-on role suited to a commercially minded finance professional who can go beyond accounting and build processes, reporting systems, and operating rhythms from the ground up.
The ideal candidate will bring strong financial acumen, excellent attention to detail, sound judgement, and the ability to independently manage sensitive financial, investor, and operational information.

Key Responsibilities Financial Management Reporting
  • Own monthly and periodic financial reporting, including PL, balance sheet, cash flow and financial projections .
  • Build, maintain and analyse cash flow models, budgets and financial forecasts .
  • Support the annual budgeting and financial planning cycle.
  • Monitor financial performance, identify variances and provide actionable insights to the leadership team.
  • Oversee finance operations including payroll and general financial administration.
Statutory, Tax Regulatory Compliance
  • Coordinate statutory and tax administration, including VAT and RD tax credit claims .
  • Work closely with external accountants, tax advisors and relevant professional advisors.
  • Maintain accurate financial and regulatory records.
  • Support compliance requirements and FCA-adjacent regulatory considerations , where applicable.
Investor Board Reporting
  • Maintain the cap table and investor register , including relevant investment terms and side letters.
  • Prepare investor updates, board packs and financial reporting materials .
  • Support capital raise processes and investor due diligence.
  • Ensure financial and operational information provided to investors and the board is accurate, timely and well presented.
Commercial Vendor Management
  • Oversee vendor and third-party contracts, including:
    • Commercial terms
    • Service-level agreements
    • Renewal dates
    • Costs and commitments
  • Maintain appropriate visibility of contractual obligations and upcoming renewals.
  • Support commercial negotiations and ensure appropriate internal approvals are obtained.
Technology Infrastructure Oversight
  • Provide commercial and governance oversight of technology infrastructure and third-party technology vendors.
  • Track infrastructure costs, vendor performance, service levels and contract renewals.
  • Work with relevant internal stakeholders to ensure technology-related commercial commitments are appropriately managed.
Risk Governance
  • Maintain the operational risk book in coordination with the Head of Risk.
  • Support regular review of operational and compliance risks.
  • Establish clear escalation paths and ownership for operational issues.
  • Develop and maintain practical business policies and procedures.
Business Operations Process Building
  • Build and improve operating processes across finance, commercial operations and governance.
  • Establish a consistent reporting rhythm covering:
    • Monthly: Board and investor reporting
    • Quarterly: Risk book review
    • Annually: Budgeting and business planning
  • Develop and maintain policies covering expense management, contract sign-off authority, data retention, vendor onboarding/offboarding and escalation procedures .
  • Identify operational gaps proactively and implement scalable processes.

Qualifications Experience
  • Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred.
  • Typically 6 + years of post-qualification experience in finance, business operations, financial control, FPA or a related area.
  • Strong experience in financial reporting, cash flow management, forecasting, budgeting and finance operations .
  • Strong financial modelling skills, with the ability to build and interrogate:
    • Cash flow models
    • Financial projections
    • Budgets
    • Cap tables
  • Experience with statutory and tax administration, including VAT .
  • Comfortable working with regulatory, compliance and governance requirements.
  • Experience managing vendors, contracts, commercial terms and SLAs .
  • Experience with investor reporting, board reporting, fundraising or due diligence will be an advantage.
  • Experience in FinTech, WealthTech, Financial Services, SaaS, Technology or a regulated/start-up environment will be preferred.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Personal Attributes
  • Process builder: Comfortable creating systems and processes where none currently exist.
  • Commercially minded: Able to understand both financial detail and broader business implications.
  • Detail-oriented: Highly accurate and diligent when handling financial and operational information.
  • Trustworthy and discreet: Demonstrates strong judgement when handling confidential financial and investor information.
  • Self-starter: Able to work independently, prioritise effectively and identify what needs to be done without constant supervision.
  • Strong communicator: Able to translate complex financial and operational information into clear, concise updates.
  • Challenger mindset: Willing to question assumptions, identify risks and raise concerns constructively.
  • Calm under pressure: Able to bring structure and clarity during periods of operational or business-critical issues.
  • Ownership mindset: Takes responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.
  • Long-term orientation: Committed to building sustainable processes and contributing to the business over the medium to long term.

What Success Looks Like
Within the role, you will be expected to establish a reliable operating rhythm across finance, reporting, governance, risk, vendors and investor communication , while providing the CEO and leadership team with accurate information and clear visibility into the financial and operational health of the business.

This role leads Kraft Heinzs Data Architecture chapter presence in GCC India, managing all Data Architects and Sr. Data Architects based in that location across every domain the chapter supports. Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Portfolio Program Manager to provide standing, exception-based orchestration across an assigned Research Development (RD) pillar. Reporting to the Head of Program Management, this individual contributor partners with Product and Engineering Pillar Leaders to maintain a connected view of portfolio commitments, dependencies, risks, capacity, readiness, and key decisions while improving delivery predictability and organizational effectiveness. Combining Agile coaching with portfolio program management, the role helps teams strengthen planning discipline, execution health, and continuous improvement while translating team-level insights into actionable portfolio visibility and leadership decision support. The role also serves as a champion for AI-enabled Program Management, continuously identifying and introducing automation, emerging technologies, and workflow improvements that increase scalability, operational efficiency, and decision-making effectiveness. The Portfolio Program Manager coordinates, synthesizes, and escalates material exceptions across teams, product areas, pillars, and functions.

Accountability for product strategy, roadmap priorities, customer outcomes, engineering architecture, technical design, staffing, performance management, team execution, Scrum practices, backlog management, Jira hygiene, funding decisions, launch approvals, and risk acceptance remains with the appropriate Product, Engineering leaders. End-to-end ownership of strategic initiatives is assumed only when explicitly assigned.

  • Establish and continuously improve portfolio metrics, dashboards, reporting practices, automation, and AI-enabled workflows that strengthen portfolio visibility, decision-making, execution transparency, and operational efficiency.

Job Summary

Radancys Global IT team is looking for a Network Engineer with 6-10 years of experience to help operate and support our enterprise network across a multi-site, hybrid-cloud environment.

Based in our Bengaluru office, you will be part of the team responsible for the day-to-day operation, availability, and performance of Radancy s corporate network. This includes office connectivity, routing and switching, Palo Alto firewalls, GlobalProtect VPN services, enterprise wireless infrastructure, and network connectivity between our corporate environment and cloud platforms.

You will work closely with our Infrastructure Lead and global IT teams to troubleshoot incidents, implement network changes, maintain infrastructure, and reduce dependency on any single network resource. You will also help ensure reliable connectivity for approximately 1,000 employees across offices and remote locations globally.

This is a corporate IT infrastructure role. While the position supports network routes and connectivity into AWS environments used by our SaaS platform, it is not responsible for operating or delivering the application platform itself.

Responsibilities

  • Administer and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls, including implementing approved firewall policy and threat-prevention changes.
  • Support and maintain Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN services for approximately 1,000 employees globally.
  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot site-to-site VPNs and other network connections between offices, data centers, cloud environments, and third parties.
  • Monitor network and VPN availability, investigate alerts, and resolve connectivity and performance issues.
  • Manage and troubleshoot enterprise routing environments using BGP, OSPF, and core routing and switching technologies.
  • Support network connectivity and routing between corporate environments and AWS, Azure, and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Manage AWS networking components relevant to corporate and hybrid connectivity, including VPCs, route tables, subnets, gateways, and related routing.
  • Manage Azure networking components, including VNets, subnets, routing, peering, gateways, and related connectivity.
  • Support enterprise wireless infrastructure, including Ruckus access points or comparable platforms, wireless design, capacity planning, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
  • Maintain DNS, DHCP, IP address management, and other foundational network services.
  • Coordinate with internet service providers, telecommunications providers, network vendors, and other third parties supporting Radancy s offices and network services.
  • Support network infrastructure and connectivity for offices across the United States, Europe, India, and other regions.
  • Plan and execute network firmware, software, and configuration updates through established testing, rollout, and change-management processes.
  • Maintain network configuration backups and support restoration or recovery activities when required.
  • Support the lifecycle of network hardware, including office deployments, upgrades, replacements, and decommissioning.
  • Execute network changes through established change-management and Change Advisory Board processes.
  • Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis following significant network incidents.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex or high-severity network issues, coordinating with the Infrastructure Lead and global IT teams as needed.
  • Support urgent network and firewall changes during security or operational incidents.
  • Maintain current network documentation, topology diagrams, inventories, operating procedures, and recovery documentation.
  • Cross-train with other network and infrastructure resources to improve operational coverage and reduce single points of failure.
  • Track and report on network capacity, availability, performance, recurring incidents, and infrastructure lifecycle needs.
  • Partner with security, cloud engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and other IT teams to maintain reliable connectivity and implement required network controls.

Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of hands-on enterprise networking experience.
  • CCNA certification or equivalent demonstrated networking knowledge and experience.
  • Proven operational experience administering and troubleshooting Palo Alto firewalls.

About the Role
We are looking for an AI/ML Data Scientist to design, build, and deploy machine learning models across our payments platform - from real-time transaction fraud detection to authorization optimization, credit/behavioral risk scoring, and anomaly detection in scheme and settlement data. Youll work with high-volume, high-velocity transactional data in a regulated, low-latency environment where model accuracy, explainability, and operational robustness all matter as much as raw predictive performance.
This role sits at the intersection of data science, payments domain expertise, and production ML engineering. Youll partner closely with Fraud Risk, Engineering, Compliance, and Product to turn data into models that run in production and not just notebooks that sit on a shelf.
Key Responsibilities
Model Development
  • Design, train, validate, and deploy ML models for use cases such as: real-time transaction fraud detection, card-not-present (CNP) risk scoring, authorization decline/approval optimization, chargeback/dispute prediction, merchant risk scoring, and AML/transaction-monitoring anomaly detection.
  • Engineer features from transactional, behavioral, and device/network data while respecting strict latency budgets (often sub-100ms scoring at authorization time).
  • Evaluate and select appropriate techniques - gradient boosting, deep learning, graph-based fraud detection, anomaly detection, time-series methods, based on the problem, not fashion.
Productionization MLOps
  • Work with Engineering to deploy models into real-time and batch pipelines, ensuring reliability, monitoring, and rollback safety in a payments-critical path.
  • Build and maintain model monitoring for drift, data quality, and performance degradation, with alerting tied to operational and fraud-loss KPIs.
  • Contribute to (or help establish) MLOps practices: versioning of models/features/data, reproducible training pipelines, CI/CD for models, and A/B or shadow-testing frameworks before full rollout.
AI/LLM-Adjacent Work
  • Apply modern AI tooling - including LLMs such as Claude - to accelerate data science workflows: automated feature exploration, model documentation, anomaly narrative generation for fraud analysts, and code generation/review for data pipelines.
  • Explore applied use cases for LLMs in risk and compliance narratives (e.g., summarizing suspicious activity patterns for SAR drafting support, with mandatory human review).
Cross-Functional Collaboration Governance
  • Partner with Fraud Risk and Compliance teams to ensure model outputs are explainable and defensible to auditors, regulators, and card scheme risk teams (Visa, Mastercard).
  • Present findings and model performance to non-technical stakeholders (Risk Committee, Product, Client Services) in clear, decision-useful terms.
  • Ensure all data handling complies with PCI DSS, data residency requirements, and internal data governance policies - particularly around cardholder data (PANs, CVVs, authentication data).
Required Qualifications
  • 10+ years of overall experience, including at least 3+ years as a Data Scientist or ML Engineer, ideally in payments, fintech, banking, or another environment with high-volume transactional data and real-time decisioning.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, PyTorch or TensorFlow) and SQL.
  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying models into production (not just research/exploratory work), with attention to monitoring and retraining considerations.
  • Solid understanding of classification, anomaly detection, and imbalanced-class problems (fraud is a classic rare-event problem).
  • Experience with cloud data/ML infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure - e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks) and standard data engineering tools (Spark, Airflow, or similar).
  • Understanding of the regulatory and security constraints of financial services data (PCI DSS, data minimization, access controls).
  • Strong communication skills - able to translate model outputs and trade-offs (precision/recall, false positive cost, latency) into business decisions for risk and product stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Direct experience with payments-specific fraud typologies: CNP fraud, account takeover, first-party fraud, synthetic identity, BIN attacks, or card testing.
  • Experience with graph-based or network analysis techniques for fraud rings/merchant collusion detection.
  • Familiarity with card scheme rules and risk parameters (Visa Risk Manager, Mastercard Fraud attributes, or similar).
  • Experience applying LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT) to data science workflows - feature engineering assistance, automated EDA, report generation, or analyst-facing summarization tools.
  • Exposure to real-time streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink) for low-latency scoring.
  • MSc/PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Math, Physics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.

Role overview

Role: Principal Data Engineer - Real-time Data Platform. Location: India, Remote. Experience: 10+ years.

This role will own the technical architecture and engineering direction across Full Load / Batch and Real-Time CDC pipelines, with real-time streaming expected to become the primary long-term ingestion pattern.

The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader and architect who remains hands-on, can guide and mentor engineers and can design production-grade ingestion solutions for scalability, resiliency, performance and data integrity.

  • Implement reconciliation and data-quality controls to ensure source-to-target completeness and accuracy.

  • Deep understanding of:
    • Pipeline design and orchestration
    • Error handling and recovery
    • Schema drift
    • Schema evolution
    • Idempotent data processing
    • Delta Tables
    • Data partitioning and optimization
    • Performance tuning
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL Server CDC, transaction logs, LSNs and high-volume transactional databases.
  • Experience with Debezium SQL Server Connector, including configuration, offsets, snapshots, recovery and schema changes.
  • Strong experience with Azure Event Hubs, including partitioning, consumer groups, scaling, throughput and checkpointing.
  • Deep understanding of batch, micro-batch, streaming and event-driven data architectures.
  • Strong experience with Python/PySpark, SQL, Azure Data Lake and distributed data processing.
  • Experience designing production-grade solutions for retry, replay, fault tolerance, duplicate handling, reconciliation and observability.
  • Strong performance engineering and troubleshooting skills across large-scale data pipelines.
  • Ability to provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, mentoring and hands-on engineering support.

Must have skills:

  • 3+ years working with production-scale CDC or real-time streaming architectures.
  • Strong production experience with Databricks and Delta Lake.
  • Experience processing millions to billions of records.
  • Experience with multi-client or multi-tenant ingestion architectures.
  • Experience implementing Medallion / Bronze-Silver-Gold architectures.

Good to have skills:

  • Experience with Apache Kafka / Kafka Connect and streaming ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions and Azure Monitor.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/ARM/Bicep) and CI/CD for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows and advanced Spark optimization.

The person in this role should be able to:

  • Establish a scalable architecture for batch and real-time ingestion.

2 rounds of discussion.

Job Details

  • Location: Pune (Koregaon Park), India

Position Overview

Mastercam seeks a Sr. Software Engineer (Cloud Integration SDK Connectivity) who will be responsible for designing and building the next generation of cloud-enabled services that integrates deeply with the Mastercam desktop product. Mastercam is a C++-based CAM application used globally and is evolving toward a hybrid desktop and cloud platform. This hands-on technical leadership role builds cloud services, contributes to integration patterns, enables real-time communication, and extends existing SDK capabilities to work seamlessly over web APIs.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Platform Web Services Development

  • Build cloud services primarily using C#/.NET on Kubernetes.
  • Design, build, and operate production-grade cloud services that integrate with the Mastercam desktop product.
  • Develop and maintain REST, gRPC, and/or JSON-RPC APIs with strong contract discipline and long-term maintainability.
  • Deliver services designed for scalability, reliability, performance, and cost awareness.
  • Apply security-first engineering practices, including secure API patterns, pipeline security, secure software supply chain practices, and service-to-service communication.
  • Build with observability in mind, including logging, metrics, and tracing, and support production operations.

Real-Time, Messaging Distributed Integration

  • Contribute to distributed integration patterns across desktop clients and cloud services.
  • Collaborate on integrations using messaging and eventing platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent.
  • Support real-time or bidirectional communication using WebSockets, SignalR, or gRPC streaming when needed.
  • Contribute to resilient and scalable integration patterns for asynchronous systems.

Data Contracts, Serialization Interoperability

  • Define and evolve data exchange contracts between desktop and cloud systems.
  • Use and maintain schema-based contracts such as Protobuf and/or JSON Schema.
  • Ensure compatibility and controlled evolution of contracts over time.
  • Integrate with external and partner services using lean and maintainable patterns.

Platform Alignment Engineering Excellence

  • Work effectively within a broader platform ecosystem owned by partner and business-unit teams.
  • Participate in identity and access management discussions and implement compliant integrations.
  • Own solutions end to end, from prototype through production and maintenance.
  • Apply best practices for code quality, testing, CI/CD, secure development, and documentation.
  • Participate in cross-team technical discussions, code reviews, and operational support.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience, preferred.
  • 10+ years of professional experience building web APIs and cloud services.
  • Strong proficiency in C#/.NET for building cloud services and APIs.
  • Experience integrating native desktop applications with cloud services, including data serialization, schema evolution, performance considerations, and large codebases.
  • Experience with streaming or bidirectional client/server communication patterns.
  • Experience designing service-based or microservice-oriented architectures.
  • Experience building or supporting developer platforms, SDKs, or extensibility frameworks preferred.
  • Experience with event-driven and messaging systems preferred.
  • Familiarity with CAD/CAM, engineering software, or manufacturing systems preferred.
  • Ability to work effectively with native desktop codebases, with C++ strongly preferred.
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools or automation to improve productivity and operational effectiveness, or a demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, evaluate, and apply such technologies at scale.

Key Competencies

  • Strong system design, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to own solutions from concept through production operations.
  • Ability to influence architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and raise engineering quality.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across desktop, cloud, and platform teams.

This role will focus on integrating an acquired company (to be acquired) to Mastercam per Sandviks and Mastercams program and processes - from a compliance and financial controls perspective.

As the integration work will go down over time, the role is expected to take broader BA wide responsibilities e.g. under the common Sandvik compliance program (and also locally for the Hub and our other local business).

Overview About Business Unit: Platform Services specializes in the implementation, management and evolution of Custom and PeopleCloud solutions, offering end-to-end support for clients. Our team of experts handles platform setup, ongoing management, and strategic enhancements, ensuring that our solutions adapt to changing business needs. From loyalty programs to digital activation, our platforms empower clients to implement campaigns, generate insights, and streamline business activities, all with a focus on seamless integration and continuous improvement. By collaborating with client partners and strategy teams, we create impactful campaigns tailored to each client s unique objectives.

About the Role: We are seeking a Test Lead - Martech Platforms with strong hands-on expertise in test automation, Python, and Playwright, and a solid foundation in modern web technologies to drive end-to-end, regression, and cross-browser testing across digital marketing platforms. This role goes beyond traditional testing, requiring a quality engineering approach, the ability to validate AI driven and data-centric systems, and close collaboration with product, engineering, data, and marketing teams. The Test Lead will be responsible for implementing scalable automation frameworks, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines, improving test coverage and execution efficiency, and ensuring high-quality, optimized digital customer experiences across Martech solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor a team of testers, providing guidance, support, and feedback to ensure high productivity and professional growth.
  • Assign tasks to team members based on their skills and areas for development, ensuring efficient utilization of resources.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive test plans and test cases based on product requirements and specifications.
  • Ensure thorough coverage of both functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using Python and Playwright; extend and optimize existing automation suites to increase test coverage, improve execution efficiency, and reduce flaky failures across end-to-end and regression scenarios.
  • Track test progress and ensure timely reporting of test results, defects, and any deviations from the plan.
  • Use advanced SQL skills to query databases for data validation and testing.
  • Write complex SQL queries to validate data transformation and integration.
  • Identify, document, and prioritize defects.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution and re-testing of defects.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business analysts, to understand requirements, clarify ambiguities, and provide testing insights.
  • Drive innovation by evaluating emerging technologies in AI, automation, and martech.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in software testing, with significant expertise in both manual and automated testing.
  • Strong understanding of software development and testing methodologies, Estimations, tools, and processes.
  • Proficiency in test automation tools - (Python, Playwright, PyTest/BDD/Keyword driven/Robot framework)
  • Experience with performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner, OWASP tools) is a plus.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with different stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple tasks simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Strong database skills (SQL, PL/SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL).
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, VSTS).
  • Exposure to digital marketing platforms, customer data platforms (CDPs), or loyalty systems is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like Jira, Confluence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong ETL and Data warehousing skills/experience is added advantage
  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks (scikit-learn, AWS AI services, or similar).
  • Knowledge of Digital Marketing platforms (Adobe Experience cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, GCP, etc.).
  • Understanding of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and ethical AI practices.
  • Consulting experience or client-facing roles in martech or digital transformation projects.

Personal Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a consultative approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Passion for innovation, automation, and delivering business value through technology.
  • Self-starter with a growth mindset and adaptability to evolving tech landscapes.

jobDescription:
Job Summary
Role: Lead Product Designer. Experience: 6+ years. Location: Navi Mumbai. Work Mode: On-site. Employment Type: Full-time.
Were looking for a Lead Product Designer who can stay hands-on while raising how design works across the team. Youll own product and UX/UI direction on complex, multi-platform projects end to end, from problem framing through polished delivery, while reviewing and mentoring other designers so the whole team ships faster and with more confidence.
Youll also own a piece of our design infrastructure, whether thats the design system, documentation standards, or critique culture, and youll be the person clients and internal stakeholders trust to explain the "why" behind a decision. AI sits inside how you work day to day: youll use it to accelerate research, critique, and design operations, and youll help other designers do the same without cutting corners on quality.


What You Will Own
  • Lead product and UX/UI work from problem framing through delivery on complex projects, translating user, business, and client needs into flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished interfaces across web and mobile.
  • Review, mentor, and unblock other designers, running critiques that raise team quality, confidence, and speed rather than just catching errors.
  • Own or improve a system-level asset, such as the design system, documentation, QA standards, file hygiene, or a recurring design ritual, and be accountable for it getting measurably better.
  • Use feedback, research inputs, and usability thinking to pressure-test design decisions before they ship.
  • Present work to clients and internal stakeholders with clarity and a strong rationale, including when the recommendation is unpopular.
  • Run first-pass research synthesis and heuristic audits with AI, then validate the output against real transcripts and sessions before it shapes a design decision.
  • Use AI to accelerate documentation and critique prep, drafting design-system notes, rationale write-ups, and review agendas so more of the teams time goes to the actual design conversation.
  • Balance multiple live projects and designers questions without becoming the bottleneck for either.


How AI Shows Up in This Role
  • Synthesizing first-pass themes from user research transcripts and support tickets before validating them against the raw sessions.
  • Running a first-pass heuristic or UX audit on a flow, then using it as a starting point for your own review, not a substitute for it.
  • Generating rapid wireframe and flow variants to explore a problem space before committing a direction to high fidelity.
  • Drafting design-system documentation, component rationale, and handoff notes so engineering gets clearer specs faster.
  • Building critique prompts and review checklists that other designers can reuse, turning a one-off AI trick into a team habit.


What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days
  • You independently own design direction on live projects without needing constant rescue.
  • Other designers are visibly using your feedback, structure, or standards to work faster and with more confidence.
  • One part of the design system, documentation, or QA workflow is noticeably stronger because of a contribution you made.
  • Your design files, handoff clarity, and documentation make collaboration smoother across design, product, and engineering.
  • Clients and stakeholders trust your communication and the rationale behind your calls.
  • Youve demonstrated at least one repeatable AI-assisted workflow that improves speed without reducing design quality, and can show a teammate how to run it.


Who You Are
  • Youd rather fix the root cause than patch the symptom.
  • You give feedback people can actually act on.
  • You stay calm and clear when a client pushes back.
  • You notice when a process is quietly wasting everyones time.


Requirements
What You Bring:
  • 6+ years of relevant UX/UI or product design experience.
  • Direct experience reviewing or mentoring other designers.
  • Experience with client-facing or stakeholder-facing work.
  • Strong UX depth across flows, wireframes, prototyping, interface design, and handoff.
  • Evidence of design-system ownership, scalable component thinking, or process improvement.
  • Experience designing complex digital products across web and/or mobile platforms.
  • A strong portfolio with at least two detailed case studies relevant to complex digital products.
  • Advanced Figma capability, including components, auto layout, design systems, prototyping, and clean file structure.
  • You design AI-assisted workflows for your own craft, know where the tools break down, and raise the bar for how the team uses them.


Nice to Have
  • Experience across SaaS, enterprise, fintech, BFSI, or multi-role products.
  • Motion or prototyping depth.
  • Experience designing or documenting an AI-assisted workflow that other designers adopted, not just used yourself.
  • Experience contributing to team rituals, critique culture, or quality review systems.


Education
Education: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Relevant work experience and practical capability will be valued more than academic specialisation.


Interview Process
  1. Application and candidate assessment
  2. Recruiter qualification call
  3. One-way video interview
  4. L1 live task interview (30 minutes)
  5. L2 hiring-manager interview
  6. L3 founder / leadership round

  • Strong experience and hands-on experience on Digital marketing operations which includes content publishing, optimisation, SEO, Personalisation & Email marketing.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Sitecore AI Lead Developer / Architect to drive the design, architecture, implementation, and adoption of AI-powered digital experience solutions using the Sitecore ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in traditional Sitecore implementations as well as emerging Sitecore AI capabilities. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can architect enterprise solutions, lead migrations from legacy Sitecore platforms to Sitecore AI-enabled platforms, guide development teams, and actively contribute to daily development and support activities.

The candidate should be passionate about learning emerging AI technologies, mentoring engineering teams, and driving AI adoption across the organization.

  • Design and integrate REST APIs, Microservices, AI services, and cloud-native solutions.
  • Establish engineering best practices for security, scalability, performance, observability, and DevOps.
  • Act as a technical mentor and coach for development teams.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and train engineers on Sitecore AI capabilities, architecture patterns, and implementation best practices.
  • Stay current with new Sitecore AI releases and evaluate their applicability to business use cases.
  • Provide hands-on support for production issues, enhancements, and ongoing development activities.

Required Technical Skills

Sitecore Expertise

  • Sitecore XP, XM, XM Cloud
  • Sitecore AI / Sitecore Stream
  • Sitecore Search
  • Sitecore Personalize
  • Sitecore Content Hub
  • Sitecore SXA
  • Sitecore JSS

  • GraphQL and webhooks

Development

  • ASP.NET Core

  • REST APIs
  • Microservices Architecture

Front - End

  • React.js
  • Next.js
  • JavaScript / TypeScript

Search & AI

  • Coveo Search
  • Sitecore Search
  • Azure OpenAI
  • Understanding of LLMs
  • Ability to work on Agentic Platforms
  • Generative AI
  • Prompt Engineering
  • Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • AI-powered Content Management and Personalization

DevOps & Cloud

  • Azure
  • Azure DevOps
  • Git
  • CI/CD Pipelines
  • Containerization and Cloud-Native Architecture

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Lead AI strategy, architecture, and adoption initiatives within the Sitecore ecosystem.
  • Drive solution architecture and technical design discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
  • Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, engineering standards, mentoring, and developer enablement.
  • Conduct cross-functional training and promote best practices for Sitecore AI and SDLC processes.
  • Design and implement enterprise AI solutions leveraging Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI Agents, Semantic Search, and Intelligent Content Platforms.
  • Lead Sitecore modernization, cloud transformation, and platform optimization initiatives.
  • Manage and influence globally distributed engineering teams and technical communities of practice.
  • Balance strategic architecture responsibilities with hands-on delivery, operational excellence, and production support.
  • Demonstrate strong ownership, innovation, continuous learning, and thought leadership in emerging AI technologies.

Good to Have

  • Cloud Certifications
  • Sitecore Certified Professional

Nice to Have

  • Any Digital Marketing Certifications & Memberships.
  • Vercel Certification
  • Agentic AI Certification

jobDescription:
Delivery Lead - Fintech & AI-Augmented Development


Role Overview

We are seeking a Delivery Lead to own end-to-end project execution for our Fintech clients at the intersection of financial services and AI. This hybrid role combines hands-on technical leadership (development or functional consulting) with project management, leveraging AI tools to accelerate prototyping, standardize development practices, and

ensure project profitability. You will work closely with PreSales to ensure seamless transition from sales to delivery and drive Fintech projects to successful completion.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Scoping (AI-Leveraged)

  • Partner with PreSales during handoff to deeply understand Fintech client requirements, regulatory constraints, and business commitments
  • Rapidly develop working prototypes using AI-assisted development tools to validate scope and feasibility for banking, markets, or payment solutions
  • Conduct detailed scoping sessions with clients to finalize requirements, timelines, and deliverables specific to financial services
  • Create detailed project plans, resource estimates, and delivery roadmaps considering Fintech compliance and security requirements
  • Identify risks early (regulatory, technical, integration) and propose mitigation strategies
  • Establish clear acceptance criteria and success metrics with clients

Technical Leadership & Framework Development

  • Design and develop reusable frameworks, templates, and accelerators for Fintech development teams
  • Leverage AI coding assistants and tools to maximize development velocity and code quality for financial applications
  • Establish coding standards, architectural patterns, and best practices specific to banking/markets/fintech solutions
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to quality standards and financial industry compliance (PCI-DSS, PSD2, GDPR, etc.)
  • Make technology stack decisions and design scalable, secure solutions for financial services
  • Hands-on development of critical components and complex integrations (core banking, payment gateways, trading platforms, etc.)
  • Create technical documentation and knowledge base artifacts

Project Management & Delivery Excellence

  • Own end-to-end project delivery from kickoff through go-live and hypercare for Fintech implementations
  • Manage project timelines, milestones, resources, and budgets
  • Track project profitability and implement corrective actions when needed
  • Lead daily standups, sprint planning, and stakeholder updates
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (developers, QA, infrastructure, client teams, compliance)
  • Manage scope changes through proper change control processes
  • Ensure timely delivery within budget and quality standards
  • Escalate risks and issues proactively with proposed solutions

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead and mentor development teams, providing technical guidance on Fintech solutions
  • Onboard and train team members on frameworks, tools, and financial services domain knowledge
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and AI adoption in Fintech context
  • Conduct performance reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Build team capabilities in AI-augmented development practices for financial applications

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as primary technical point of contact during Fintech project execution
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders (CTOs, Product Owners, Compliance teams)
  • Manage client expectations and communicate progress transparently
  • Identify opportunities for additional services or expansion within Fintech domain
  • Ensure high client satisfaction and successful project outcomes

What You'll Gain (Value Add)

Techno-Functional Acumen

  • Deep exposure to Fintech business problems across banking, capital markets, payments, and wealth management
  • Hands-on experience with cutting-edge AI development tools applied to financial services
  • Opportunity to architect and build solutions for regulated industries from ground up
  • Develop expertise in financial technology stacks, APIs, and integration patterns
  • Build skills in rapid prototyping and agile delivery practices for Fintech
  • Understand regulatory requirements and compliance considerations in financial services

Commercial & Leadership Acumen

  • Direct accountability for project profitability and P&L management in high-value Fintech engagements
  • Experience managing client relationships in banking and financial services
  • Develop skills in resource planning, budgeting, and financial management
  • Learn to balance technical excellence with commercial realities in regulated environments
  • Build leadership capabilities through team management and mentorship
  • Gain exposure to Fintech sales cycles and business development through PreSales collaboration

Career Growth

  • Position yourself at the intersection of Fintech, AI, and delivery leadership
  • Develop a unique blend of technical depth, domain expertise, and strategic leadership
  • Build a track record of successful Fintech project deliveries and satisfied financial institution clients
  • Opportunity to influence company's Fintech delivery methodology and AI tooling decisions
  • Path to senior leadership roles in Fintech practice management or delivery excellence

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • 8-12 years of experience in software development or functional consulting
  • Mandatory: 3+ years of experience in Fintech, Banking, Capital Markets, or Financial Services projects within the last 5 years
  • 3+ years of experience in project management or delivery leadership
  • Proven experience in hands-on development or functional implementation
  • Strong understanding of modern development frameworks and architectures
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.)
  • Understanding of financial services regulations and compliance requirements
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certification (preferred)
  • Excellent client-facing and communication skills
  • Experience managing teams of 20 developers/BA/Testers
  • Track record of delivering projects on time and within budget

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with any Fintech technology stacks: core banking systems, payment platforms, trading systems, risk management, or wealth or consumer banking solutions
  • Knowledge of any of these financial APIs, Open Banking, PSD2, SWIFT, ISO 20022, or FIX protocols
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) in regulated financial services environments
  • Experience with data analytics, AI/ML applications in financial services (fraud detection, Lending, Collateral, credit scoring, algorithmic trading, etc.)
  • Industry certifications (e.g., ACCA/CA CFA, FRM, or Fintech-specific certifications)
  • Background in consulting or professional services for financial institutions
  • Experience building reusable frameworks or accelerators for Fintech
  • Familiarity with project financials, resource utilization, and margin management

Key Performance Indicators

  • Project delivery on time and within budget
  • Project profitability and margin achievement
  • Client satisfaction scores
  • Team productivity and quality metrics
  • Reusable Fintech asset creation and adoption
  • AI tool adoption and effectiveness
  • Compliance and regulatory adherence in delivered solutions
